<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₇H₁₂N₂O (exact mass 140.09496 Da, within typical MS tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C7H12N2O.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
